title: O‘zbekiston Respublikasining “Avtomobil yo‘llari to‘g‘risida”gi Qonuni (O‘RQ-1162-son, 05.08.2026)
abs: 2026-yil 5-avgustda imzolangan yangi tahrirdagi qonun. Avtomobil yo‘llarini umumiy foydalanishdagi, ichki (shahar va aholi punktlari ko‘chalari) va xo‘jalik yo‘llariga ajratadi, Avtomobil yo‘llari qo‘mitasini sohadagi maxsus vakolatli organ sifatida belgilaydi va pulli yo‘llarni tashkil etish tartibini, jumladan muqobil bepul yo‘l bo‘lishi shartini mustahkamlaydi. Havola qonun haqidagi rasmiy axborotga olib boradi; to‘liq matn Lex.uz milliy bazasida.

title: SHNQ 2.05.02-23 “Avtomobil yo‘llari. Loyihalash talablari” shaharsozlik normalari va qoidalari
authors: O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Qurilish va uy-joy kommunal xo‘jaligi vazirligi
org: Qurilish va uy-joy kommunal xo‘jaligi vazirligi
abs: Vazirning 2024-yil 23-avgustdagi 01/2-61-son buyrug‘i bilan tasdiqlangan normalar. Yangi qurilayotgan, ta’mirlanadigan va rekonstruksiya qilinadigan umumiy foydalanishdagi hamda shaharcha, qishloq, ovul va xo‘jalik avtomobil yo‘llarini loyihalashga qo‘yiladigan talablarni belgilaydi; bog‘liq standartlar (ko‘priklar, yoritish, asfaltbeton qorishmalari) ro‘yxatini o‘z ichiga oladi.

title: ShNQ 2.05.03-22 «Ko‘priklar va quvurlar» shaharsozlik normalari va qoidalariga qo‘shimchalar kiritish to‘g‘risida (17-son, 23.01.2024)
authors: O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Qurilish va uy-joy kommunal xo‘jaligi vazirligi
org: Qurilish va uy-joy kommunal xo‘jaligi vazirligi
abs: Avtomobil yo‘llaridagi ko‘priklar va suv o‘tkazuvchi quvurlarni loyihalash normalariga yangi 5¹-bob qo‘shilgan buyruq. Sun’iy inshootlar bo‘yicha amaldagi me’yoriy bazani kuzatib borish uchun asosiy manba.

title: Avtomobil yo‘llarini qurish, rekonstruksiya qilish, ta’mirlash va ulardan foydalanish ishlarini tashkil etish chora-tadbirlari to‘g‘risida (Vazirlar Mahkamasining 901-son qarori, 30.12.2024)
abs: PQ-330 qaroriga muvofiq qabul qilingan qaror. Bajarilgan ishlarni hajm uslubida hisobga olish tartibi, avtomobil yo‘llarini ta’mirlash va saqlash ishlari tasnifi, tugallangan obyektlarni qabul qilish hamda yo‘llardagi tabiiy va texnogen favqulodda vaziyatlar oqibatlarini bartaraf etish tartibini belgilovchi ilovalarni o‘z ichiga oladi.

title: Yo‘l xo‘jaligi sohasini yanada takomillashtirish chora-tadbirlari to‘g‘risida (Prezidentning PQ-330-son qarori, 10.10.2023)
abs: Yo‘l xo‘jaligi tizimini isloh qilishga qaratilgan qaror; 2023-yil 16-oktabrdan kuchga kirgan. Keyingi hukumat qarorlari, jumladan ishlarni tashkil etish tartibi shu hujjat asosida ishlab chiqilgan.

title: Sement-beton qoplamali avtomobil yo‘llari tarmog‘ini kengaytirish chora-tadbirlari to‘g‘risida (PQ-249-son qarori, 18.05.2022)
abs: Davlat ahamiyatidagi yo‘llarda sement-beton qoplamalarni kengaytirishga qaratilgan Prezident qarori. Qattiq qoplamali yo‘llar bo‘yicha tadqiqot va loyiha ishlari uchun asosiy siyosiy-huquqiy manba.

title: O‘zbekiston Respublikasining “Avtomobil yo‘llari to‘g‘risida”gi Qonuni (653-XII-son, 03.07.1992)
abs: Mustaqillikdan keyin qabul qilingan birinchi yo‘l qonuni: yo‘llarni umumiy foydalanishdagi va korxonalarga qarashli turlarga ajratgan, xalqaro ahamiyatdagi yo‘llar tushunchasini kiritgan. 2007-yil 2-oktabrdagi O‘RQ-117 qonuni bilan kuchini yo‘qotgan; tarixiy-huquqiy manba sifatida saqlanadi.

title: ShNQ 2.05.02-07 “Avtomobil yo‘llari” (03.07.2008)
authors: O‘zbekiston Respublikasi Davlat arxitektura va qurilish qo‘mitasi
abs: Uzoq yillar amalda bo‘lgan avtomobil yo‘llarini loyihalash normalari; yo‘l toifalari, hisobiy tezliklar va harakat jadalligiga oid asosiy parametrlarni belgilagan. Lex.uz ma’lumotiga ko‘ra 2024-yil 14-oktabrdan kuchini yo‘qotgan.

title: СНиП 2.05.02-85 «Автомобильные дороги»
abs: Sovet davri avtomobil yo‘llarini loyihalash normalari (Gosstroyning 1985-yil 17-dekabrdagi 233-son qarori). Yo‘l toifalari, yo‘l poyi va yo‘l to‘shamasi qatlamlari bo‘yicha talablar keyingi milliy normalarga asos bo‘lgan; tarixiy taqqoslash uchun muhim.

title: O‘zbekiston avtomobil yo‘llari infratuzilmasining hududiy tarkibidagi o‘zgarishlar
abs: FarDU ilmiy xabarlari, 2025, 31-jild, 3-son. Maqolada respublika yo‘l tarmog‘ining hududlar bo‘yicha joylashuvi, xalqaro va davlat ahamiyatidagi yo‘nalishlar tahlil qilinib, hududiy tarkibni takomillashtirish bo‘yicha takliflar berilgan.

title: Avtomobil yo‘llarini karst jarayonlari rivojlangan joylarda loyihalashning o‘ziga xosligi
abs: “Yangi O‘zbekistonda tabiiy va ijtimoiy-gumanitar fanlar” respublika konferensiyasi materiallari (2-jild, 3-son, 30–34-betlar). Karst jarayonlari rivojlangan hududlarda yo‘l trassasini tanlash va yo‘l poyini loyihalash xususiyatlari ko‘rib chiqilgan. Ochiq kirish (Zenodo).

title: Avtomobil yo‘llari yo‘l poyi ko‘tarmasining loyihalash me’yoriy ko‘rsatkichlarini takomillashtirish (Samarqand viloyati misolida)
abs: Texnika fanlari bo‘yicha falsafa doktori (PhD) dissertatsiyasi, 05.09.02 – “Geotexnika” ixtisosligi. Himoya TDTU huzuridagi PhD.10/2025.27.12.T.01.05 Ilmiy kengashida 2026-yil 15-iyulda belgilangan. Havola rasmiy himoya e’loniga olib boradi; avtoreferat va dissertatsiya matni muallif roziligi bilan qo‘shilishi mumkin.

title: Avtomobil yo‘llari holatini ko‘rsatuvchi ochiq elektron xarita
abs: Transport vazirligi huzuridagi Avtomobil yo‘llari qo‘mitasining rasmiy sahifasidagi interaktiv xarita: umumiy foydalanishdagi yo‘llarning holati bo‘yicha ochiq ma’lumotlar. Dala tadqiqotlari va loyiha ishlarida vizual manba sifatida foydalanish mumkin.

title: Uzbekistan: Building Blocks for Integrated Transport and Logistics Sector Development
abs: World Bank policy paper reviewing Uzbekistan's transport and logistics sector and setting out the institutional and policy building blocks for an integrated, multimodal development approach, including the role of roads within the national logistics system.

uz.t: O‘zbekiston: integratsiyalashgan transport va logistika sohasini rivojlantirishning asosiy tamoyillari
uz.ab: Jahon bankining siyosiy hujjati. O‘zbekiston transport va logistika sohasini tahlil qilib, ko‘p turli transportni birgalikda rivojlantirish uchun zarur institutsional va siyosiy asoslarni, jumladan avtomobil yo‘llarining milliy logistika tizimidagi o‘rnini ko‘rsatib beradi.

title: Republic of Uzbekistan: Road Subsector Development Strategy and Action Plan (TA 9987-UZB)
abs: Technical assistance consultant's report prepared for the Committee for Roads and ADB (April 2021). Sets out a strategy and action plan for the republican road network covering institutions, funding, asset management, design standards, network management, investment priorities and monitoring.

uz.t: O‘zbekiston Respublikasi: avtomobil yo‘llari kichik sohasini rivojlantirish strategiyasi va harakatlar rejasi
uz.ab: Osiyo taraqqiyot banki texnik ko‘mak loyihasi doirasida Avtomobil yo‘llari qo‘mitasi uchun tayyorlangan hisobot (2021-yil aprel). Respublika yo‘l tarmog‘i bo‘yicha institutlar, moliyalashtirish, aktivlarni boshqarish, loyihalash standartlari, investitsiya ustuvorliklari va monitoringni qamrab olgan strategiya va reja.

title: Global Status Report on Road Safety 2023
abs: WHO's fifth global report on road safety. Estimates annual road traffic deaths at 1.19 million, reviews progress during the 2011–2020 Decade of Action and sets the baseline for the 2021–2030 target of halving deaths and injuries; country profiles, including Uzbekistan, accompany the report.

uz.t: Yo‘l harakati xavfsizligi holati bo‘yicha global hisobot, 2023
uz.ab: JSSTning yo‘l xavfsizligi bo‘yicha beshinchi global hisoboti. Yo‘l-transport hodisalarida yiliga 1,19 million kishi halok bo‘lishini baholaydi, 2011–2020 yillardagi Harakatlar o‘n yilligi natijalarini sarhisob qiladi va 2030 yilgacha o‘lim va jarohatlarni ikki baravar kamaytirish maqsadi uchun boshlang‘ich ko‘rsatkichlarni belgilaydi. Mamlakatlar, jumladan O‘zbekiston profillari ilova qilingan.

title: The Long-Term Pavement Performance Program (FHWA-HRT-15-049)
abs: Comprehensive FHWA report on the Long-Term Pavement Performance programme: its history since the Strategic Highway Research Program, test-section experiments, data collection and the main findings on how design, materials, traffic and climate affect pavement performance.

uz.t: Yo‘l qoplamalarining uzoq muddatli ishlash dasturi (LTPP)
uz.ab: AQSh Federal avtomobil yo‘llari ma’muriyatining LTPP dasturi bo‘yicha keng qamrovli hisoboti: tajriba uchastkalari, ma’lumotlar yig‘ish usullari hamda loyiha, materiallar, transport yuklamasi va iqlim qoplamaning ishlashiga qanday ta’sir qilishi haqidagi asosiy xulosalar.

title: Regional Roads Development Project (P146334) — Project Appraisal Document (PAD1270)
abs: Appraisal document for a proposed IDA credit of SDR 145 million (US$200 million) to rehabilitate regional roads in Uzbekistan. Covers project design, results framework and monitoring (including IRI and travel-speed indicators), road sector governance review, safeguards and implementation arrangements.

uz.t: Mintaqaviy yo‘llarni rivojlantirish loyihasi (P146334) — loyihani baholash hujjati
uz.ab: O‘zbekistonda mintaqaviy yo‘llarni tiklash uchun 145 mln SDR (200 mln AQSh dollari) miqdoridagi XTA krediti bo‘yicha Jahon banki baholash hujjati. Loyiha tuzilmasi, natijalar ko‘rsatkichlari (IRI va harakat tezligi), yo‘l sohasini boshqarishni ko‘rib chiqish va amalga oshirish tartibini o‘z ichiga oladi.

title: Connectivity and Transport Sector Improvement Project (P509487) — Project Information Document
abs: Project information document for a World Bank operation (approved March 2026) aiming to improve road connectivity, safety and climate resilience in Surkhandarya region and to strengthen transport sector institutions in Uzbekistan; summarises sector context and past Bank support, including the first road PPP.

uz.t: Transport bog‘liqligi va sohasini takomillashtirish loyihasi (P509487) — loyiha haqida ma’lumot hujjati
uz.ab: Jahon bankining 2026-yil martida ma’qullangan loyihasi: Surxondaryo viloyatida yo‘l bog‘liqligi, xavfsizligi va iqlimga chidamliligini oshirish hamda transport sohasi institutlarini mustahkamlash. Soha holati va bankning avvalgi ko‘magi, jumladan yo‘l sohasidagi birinchi DXSh loyihasi qisqacha bayon etilgan.

title: CAREC Road Safety Engineering Manual 1: Road Safety Audit
abs: Practical reference for the road safety audit process in CAREC countries (March 2018): what an audit is, its objectives, how to manage and carry it out at each project stage, with checklists. Endorsed by CAREC members as an integral part of road project planning, design and construction.

uz.t: CAREC yo‘l xavfsizligi muhandisligi qo‘llanmasi 1: Yo‘l xavfsizligi auditi
uz.ab: CAREC mamlakatlarida yo‘l xavfsizligi auditini o‘tkazish bo‘yicha amaliy qo‘llanma (2018-yil mart): audit nima, uning maqsadlari, loyihaning har bir bosqichida uni tashkil etish va o‘tkazish tartibi, tekshiruv varaqalari bilan.

title: CAREC Road Safety Engineering Manual 2: Safer Road Works
abs: Good-practice guidance for safe road worksites on CAREC roads (March 2018), protecting both road users and workers. Intended as the main reference for road works in contract documents of CAREC road projects.

uz.t: CAREC qo‘llanmasi 2: Yo‘l ishlarini xavfsiz tashkil etish
uz.ab: CAREC yo‘llarida ish olib boriladigan uchastkalarni yo‘l harakati ishtirokchilari va ishchilar uchun xavfsiz tashkil etish bo‘yicha ilg‘or tajriba (2018-yil mart). CAREC loyihalari shartnoma hujjatlarida asosiy manba sifatida tavsiya etiladi.

title: CAREC Road Safety Engineering Manual 3: Roadside Hazard Management
abs: Manual on managing roadside hazards (April 2018): identifying dangerous roadside objects, treatment options, the three groups of safety barriers and safer roadside furniture.

uz.t: CAREC qo‘llanmasi 3: Yo‘l yoqasidagi xavflarni boshqarish
uz.ab: Yo‘l yoqasidagi xavfli obyektlarni aniqlash va bartaraf etish, to‘siqlarning uch guruhi va xavfsiz yo‘l jihozlari bo‘yicha qo‘llanma (2018-yil aprel).

title: CAREC Road Safety Engineering Manual 4: Pedestrian Safety
abs: Manual on providing safer pedestrian facilities in CAREC countries (February 2021), focusing on physical road infrastructure and planning for pedestrian safety. Also available in Russian on the CAREC website.

uz.t: CAREC qo‘llanmasi 4: Piyodalar xavfsizligi
uz.ab: CAREC mamlakatlarida piyodalar uchun xavfsiz infratuzilmani loyihalash va rejalashtirish bo‘yicha qo‘llanma (2021-yil fevral). CAREC saytida rus tilidagi versiyasi ham mavjud.

title: CAREC Road Safety Engineering Manual 6: Identifying, Investigating, and Treating Blackspots
abs: Guidance for engineers, police and planners (May 2024) on finding high-crash locations, investigating them and choosing treatments, and on prioritising funding toward sites where treatment is most cost-effective.

uz.t: CAREC qo‘llanmasi 6: Avariya o‘choqlarini aniqlash, tekshirish va bartaraf etish
uz.ab: Muhandislar, politsiya va rejalashtiruvchilar uchun qo‘llanma (2024-yil may): YTH ko‘p sodir bo‘ladigan joylarni aniqlash, tekshirish, chora tanlash va mablag‘ni eng samarali uchastkalarga yo‘naltirish.

title: CAREC Road Safety Engineering Manual 7: Why and How to Manage Speed
abs: Manual (August 2024) on the role of speed in road safety in CAREC countries: setting appropriate speed limits and operating speeds, road design and engineering measures, vehicle technology and enforcement, with recommendations for road authorities.

uz.t: CAREC qo‘llanmasi 7: Tezlikni nima uchun va qanday boshqarish kerak
uz.ab: CAREC mamlakatlarida tezlikning yo‘l xavfsizligidagi o‘rni haqida qo‘llanma (2024-yil avgust): tezlik chegaralarini belgilash, yo‘l loyihalash va muhandislik choralari, transport vositalari texnologiyalari va nazorat bo‘yicha tavsiyalar.

title: PIARC Road Safety Manual: A manual for practitioners and decision makers on implementing Safe System infrastructure (2nd edition)
abs: Free online manual of the World Road Association, first released in 2015 and updated in 2019, to help countries at any stage of infrastructure development meet road safety objectives. Three parts, downloadable by chapter; available in English, French and Spanish.

uz.t: PIARC yo‘l xavfsizligi qo‘llanmasi: “Xavfsiz tizim” infratuzilmasini joriy etish bo‘yicha amaliyotchilar va qaror qabul qiluvchilar uchun qo‘llanma
uz.ab: Jahon yo‘l assotsiatsiyasining bepul onlayn qo‘llanmasi (2015, 2019-yilda yangilangan). Infratuzilma rivojlanishining istalgan bosqichidagi mamlakatlarga yo‘l xavfsizligi maqsadlariga erishishda yordam beradi; boblar bo‘yicha yuklab olinadi.

title: Overseas Road Note 31: A Guide to the Structural Design of Bitumen-Surfaced Roads in Tropical and Sub-Tropical Countries (4th edition)
abs: Classic TRL guide to the structural design of new bitumen-surfaced roads carrying up to 30 million equivalent standard axles in hot climates: traffic estimation, subgrade assessment, drainage, materials and a pavement design catalogue. A 5th edition (Road Note 31) was published in 2022.

uz.t: Road Note 31: Issiq iqlimli mamlakatlarda bitum qoplamali yo‘llarni konstruktiv loyihalash bo‘yicha qo‘llanma (4-nashr)
uz.ab: TRLning issiq iqlim sharoitida 30 mln ekvivalent standart o‘qgacha yuklama ko‘taradigan yangi bitum qoplamali yo‘llarni loyihalash bo‘yicha mumtoz qo‘llanmasi: transport oqimini baholash, grunt asos, drenaj, materiallar va qoplama konstruksiyalari katalogi. O‘zbekistonning issiq yozi uchun ayniqsa dolzarb; 2022-yilda 5-nashri chiqqan.

title: NCHRP Report 673: A Manual for Design of Hot-Mix Asphalt with Commentary
abs: Manual incorporating advances in materials characterisation and hot-mix asphalt mix design technology, with commentary; companion spreadsheet tool and training materials available. Free PDF download from the National Academies Press.

uz.t: NCHRP 673-hisobot: Issiq asfaltbeton aralashmalarini loyihalash bo‘yicha sharhli qo‘llanma
uz.ab: Materiallarni tavsiflash va asfaltbeton aralashmalarini loyihalash texnologiyasidagi yutuqlarni jamlagan qo‘llanma; hisob-kitob jadvali va o‘quv materiallari ilova qilingan. Milliy akademiyalar nashriyotidan bepul PDF.

title: The Design of Bitumen-Surfaced Roads in Tropical and Sub-Tropical Countries — the 4th Edition of Overseas Road Note 31
abs: Article in the TRL Annual Review 1994 (pp. 59–64) introducing the 4th edition of Overseas Road Note 31 and its approach to pavement base, subgrade, seal coats and maintenance costs in hot climates. Indexed in the TRID international database.

uz.t: Issiq iqlimli mamlakatlarda bitum qoplamali yo‘llarni loyihalash — Road Note 31 ning 4-nashri
uz.ab: TRL yillik sharhida (1994, 59–64-betlar) chop etilgan maqola: Road Note 31 4-nashrining asos qatlam, grunt, sirt ishlov berish va ta’mirlash xarajatlariga yondashuvi. TRID xalqaro bazasida indekslangan.

title: Karayolu Teknik Şartnamesi (KTŞ 2023)
abs: Turkey's General Directorate of Highways road technical specification, revised to current national and international standards and put into force on 27.12.2023. The electronic edition is available through the KGM website (Technical Publications) and e-Government. The linked KGM R&D activity report describes the revision.

uz.t: Turkiya avtomobil yo‘llari texnik shartnomasi (KTŞ 2023)
uz.ab: Turkiya Avtomobil yo‘llari bosh boshqarmasining yo‘l qurilishi texnik shartlari; amaldagi milliy va xalqaro standartlar asosida qayta ishlanib, 2023-yil 27-dekabrdan kuchga kirgan. Elektron nashri KGM saytidagi “Texnik nashrlar” bo‘limida. Havola qayta ishlash haqidagi KGM hisobotiga olib boradi.

title: Karayolu Trafik İşaretleme Standartları
abs: KGM standard for road traffic signs and markings, issued under the Highway Traffic Law and the presidential decree on agency organisation. Original in Turkish.

uz.t: Turkiya: yo‘l harakatini belgilash standartlari
uz.ab: KGM tomonidan yo‘l belgilari va yotiq chiziqlar bo‘yicha qabul qilingan standart. Asl matni turk tilida.

title: Road Structure Ordinance (Government Ordinance No. 320 of 29 October 1970)
authors: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT)
abs: Japan's general technical standard for road structure: road classification, design vehicles, cross-section elements, design speed, alignment, bridges (design vehicle load 245 kN) and tunnels. Official English text published by MLIT; revised several times, most recently for bicycle traffic zones (2019).

uz.t: Yaponiya: Yo‘l konstruksiyasi to‘g‘risidagi hukumat farmoni (№320, 1970)
uz.ab: Yaponiyada yo‘llarni loyihalashning asosiy texnik me’yori: yo‘l toifalari, hisobiy transport vositalari, ko‘ndalang kesim elementlari, hisobiy tezlik, trassa, ko‘priklar (hisobiy yuklama 245 kN) va tunnellar. MLIT rasmiy inglizcha matni; bir necha bor yangilangan, oxirgisi velosiped yo‘laklari bo‘yicha (2019).

title: Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD), 11th Edition
abs: US national standard for traffic signs, signals and pavement markings. The 11th edition was published on 19 December 2023 (effective 18 January 2024) as the first major update in 14 years; FHWA has since issued Revision 1 (December 2025). Available free as PDF.

uz.t: AQSh: Harakatni boshqarish vositalari bo‘yicha yagona qo‘llanma (MUTCD), 11-nashr
uz.ab: AQShda yo‘l belgilari, svetoforlar va yo‘l chiziqlari bo‘yicha milliy standart. 11-nashr 2023-yil 19-dekabrda chiqqan (2024-yil 18-yanvardan amalda) — 14 yildagi birinchi yirik yangilanish; 2025-yil dekabrida 1-tahrir qo‘shilgan. PDF shaklida bepul.

title: СП 34.13330.2021 «Автомобильные дороги» (актуализированная редакция СНиП 2.05.02-85*)
abs: Rossiyada aholi punktlaridan tashqaridagi umumiy foydalanishdagi avtomobil yo‘llarini loyihalash qoidalari to‘plami; 2021-yil 9-fevralda tasdiqlangan, ishlab chiquvchi — MADI. SNiP 2.05.02-85 ning yangilangan tahriri; O‘zbekiston normalari bilan taqqoslash uchun muhim.

uz.t: SP 34.13330.2021 “Avtomobil yo‘llari” (SNiP 2.05.02-85* ning yangilangan tahriri)
uz.ab: Rossiyada aholi punktlaridan tashqaridagi umumiy foydalanishdagi yo‘llarni loyihalash me’yorlari; 2021-yilda tasdiqlangan, ishlab chiquvchi — MADI.

title: JTG B01-2014 Technical Standard of Highway Engineering (公路工程技术标准)
authors: Ministry of Transport of the People's Republic of China
abs: China's basic industry standard for highway engineering, issued 30 September 2014 and in force since 1 January 2015, replacing JTG B01-2003. Applies to new, reconstructed and expanded highways. The linked Ministry of Transport document lists the current JTG standard system, headed by JTG B01-2014; the Chinese text is public, official English editions are sold separately.

uz.t: Xitoy: JTG B01-2014 Avtomobil yo‘llari muhandisligi texnik standarti
uz.ab: Xitoyda avtomobil yo‘llari muhandisligining asosiy tarmoq standarti; 2014-yil 30-sentabrda chiqarilgan, 2015-yil 1-yanvardan amalda. Havola Xitoy Transport vazirligining amaldagi JTG standartlar ro‘yxatiga olib boradi.

title: RAA — Guidelines for the Design of Motorways, Edition 2008 (English translation 2011)
abs: German guidelines for the design of motorways (Richtlinien für die Anlage von Autobahnen, RAA), introduced federally by circular ARS 7/2009. FGSV provides the official English translation free of charge.

uz.t: Germaniya: Avtomagistrallarni loyihalash bo‘yicha yo‘riqnoma (RAA, 2008)
uz.ab: Germaniyada avtomagistrallarni loyihalash qoidalari; federal darajada 2009-yilda joriy etilgan. FGSV rasmiy inglizcha tarjimasini bepul taqdim etadi.

title: СП РК 3.03-101-2013 «Автомобильные дороги» (с изменениями от 25.02.2019)
authors: Комитет по делам строительства и ЖКХ РК
abs: Qozog‘istonda avtomobil yo‘llarini loyihalash qoidalari to‘plami: SN RK 3.03-01-2013 ning majburiy talablarini bajarish uchun maqbul yechimlarni tavsiflaydi. Qo‘shni davlat bilan transport yo‘laklarini loyihalashda taqqoslash uchun foydali.

uz.t: Qozog‘iston: SP RK 3.03-101-2013 “Avtomobil yo‘llari”
uz.ab: Qozog‘istonda avtomobil yo‘llarini loyihalash qoidalari to‘plami (2019-yilgi o‘zgarishlar bilan).

title: СН РК 3.03-04-2014 «Проектирование дорожных одежд нежесткого типа»
authors: Комитет по делам строительства и ЖКХ РК
abs: Qozog‘istonning egiluvchan (nobikr) turdagi yo‘l to‘shamalarini loyihalash bo‘yicha qurilish normalari; rasmiy matn Adilet huquqiy bazasida.

uz.t: Qozog‘iston: SN RK 3.03-04-2014 “Egiluvchan yo‘l to‘shamalarini loyihalash”
uz.ab: Qozog‘istonda egiluvchan turdagi yo‘l to‘shamalarini loyihalash qurilish normalari.

title: Road Act of the Republic of Korea (English translation)
authors: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport (MOLIT)
abs: Official English translation of Korea's Road Act from the Korea Law Translation Center: road planning, management, use and the criteria for the structure and facilities of roads (Article 50), which are detailed in subordinate MOLIT rules.

uz.t: Koreya Respublikasining Yo‘llar to‘g‘risidagi qonuni (inglizcha tarjima)
uz.ab: Koreya qonunlar tarjima markazining rasmiy inglizcha tarjimasi: yo‘llarni rejalashtirish, boshqarish, foydalanish hamda yo‘l konstruksiyasi va inshootlariga qo‘yiladigan mezonlar (50-modda).

title: Saudi Roads Code (launched 27 May 2024)
abs: Unified technical reference for all road agencies in Saudi Arabia, prepared to international best practice. It comprises 25 codes covering planning and preliminary studies, design, construction and maintenance of roads, bridges and tunnels, traffic engineering and road safety.

uz.t: Saudiya Arabistoni yo‘l kodeksi (2024)
uz.ab: Saudiya Arabistonidagi barcha yo‘l tashkilotlari uchun yagona texnik manba; 25 ta koddan iborat: rejalashtirish, loyihalash, yo‘l, ko‘prik va tunnellarni qurish va saqlash, harakatni tashkil etish va xavfsizlik.

title: Umumiy foydalanilmaydigan qattiq qoplamali avtomobil yo‘llarining uzunligi — statistik ko‘rsatkich metama’lumotlari (SDMX)
abs: Milliy statistika qo‘mitasining ochiq ma’lumotlar portalidagi ko‘rsatkich (kod 1.06.01.0030) pasporti: ta’rif, hisoblash usuli, birlamchi manba va transport statistikasi uslubiy nizomiga havola. Uch tilda (o‘zbek, rus, ingliz).
